title: MACHINE TELLS AND OPEN BEATS
why: His g-20 and g-29: a red streak at your feet and a short open beat. Watch: the bulwark big shot hits 2.5x and changes its rhythm; watch that it reads clearly, avoids cheap deaths, and the opening is noticed. Watch that the streak reads as incoming danger rather than your aim and never appears for a machine targeting somebody else.
now: Wardens open for 0.9s after firing. Every fourth bulwark shot charges for 0.7s, hits 2.5x, then opens its shield for 1s. Hidden machine windups warn only their target at their feet.
